task: A01 retrospective real-CDM analysis under the frozen Track R analysis choices
evidence_type: exposed retrospective; never pooled with simulation or with any new-cohort confirmation
cohort: retrospective benchmark training cohort: 8,293 eligible events, 66 with final log-risk >= -6, 2-day cutoff
folds: the outer 5 / inner 3 whole-event folds of cv_20261009_v2, regenerated by research.evaluate.folds with seed 20261009 and required to equal its splits.parquet exactly
external_reference_arm: causal_gbm OOF predictions reused unchanged from cv_20261009_v2 (different model family; not refitted)
selection_and_calibration: Minimum inner-OOF clipped log loss (1e-6), ties to smaller C; monotone Platt on selected inner OOF; training-only thresholds at nominal 90/95/99% recall; refit on the outer training fold. Unchanged from cv_20261009_v2 except the grid, iteration cap and convergence rule.
historical_test: Final models are selected and calibrated by 3-fold inner CV on the full training cohort (fold seed 20261108), refitted on it, and evaluated once on the 2,167-event / 150-positive historical test split. Those labels are exposed (Kelvins) but were never used for any model choice in this project; results are labelled exposed.

analyses.metrics: log loss, Brier, AUC, average precision, review and miss counts at nominal 90/95/99% training recall (OOF and historical test)
analyses.calibration: logistic recalibration intercept and slope on logit(q); decile reliability bins with counts and positives
analyses.frontiers: review fraction versus missed positives over 101 OOF score quantiles; training-selected operating points marked; descriptive only

paired_contrasts.role: real-data analog of S1: does a history summary beat the latest message?
real-data analog of S2: does label-free grouping help?
value of latest-message metadata beyond latest risk
strongest existing real-data model versus the frozen comparator (OOF only)

analyses.interval: event-level studentized bootstrap (B = 9,999, seed 20261109); mission-cluster bootstrap-t as dependence sensitivity
analyses.censoring: final log-risk at the -30 floor is treated as censored; contrasts repeated on events above the floor; floor share by mission and label
analyses.failure_analysis: missed positives at the 95% nominal threshold for each arm, with mission, latest risk and final risk

failure_policy: Any convergence warning, fold mismatch, nonfinite value or count mismatch stops the run; partial records retained; a retry uses a new run ID.
